summary: Customer-controlled webhook audit lease and timestamped acknowledgement package
description:
Issue summary: NorthStar Payments requests a short-term, customer-controlled webhook 'lease' for audit events covering a legal investigation window. They need each delivered event to carry a server-signed timestamped acknowledgement token and an HMAC of the payload. Deliverable should include a tamper-evident bundle (signed manifest) that proves delivery order and non-repudiation for the leased window.

Impact: Customer cannot complete an AML internal investigation and third-party pen test until they can ingest a provable stream. The ask affects a single production tenant and is time-sensitive (legal request, 72-hour window).

Environment: prod us-east (tenant ns-payments-prod).

Requested artifacts: 1) A timebound webhook lease that routes audit events for tenant ns-payments-prod to a customer-provided HTTPS endpoint for a 72-hour window. 2) Per-event acknowledgement tokens signed by Redwood's audit service (ed25519) and an HMAC header (sha256) keyed by the tenant envelope key. 3) A signed manifest at the end of the lease containing per-event sequence numbers, event hashes, and a canonical ordering proof. 4) Playbook text describing verification steps for the customer to validate the manifest and signatures.

Customer-provided constraints: endpoint supports mutual TLS. Customer requires no redaction of low-level fields during the leased window (they have legal basis). They also want resume tokens to allow replays within the 72-hour lease only.

Steps to reproduce / test harness: 1) On Redwood side, provision a temporary webhook route for tenant ns-payments-prod with mTLS and per-event HMAC headers. 2) Send a continuous stream of audit events from prod (sampling all write events) for 1 hour. 3) Confirm receipt of acknowledgement tokens and that the final signed manifest enumerates all sequence numbers in order and that the manifest signature verifies with our audit key.

Logs / artifacts provided by customer: initial request email thread, mTLS cert bundle from customer, endpoint URL, and a sample of 3 events they expect in the lease window.

Acceptance criteria: customer can validate per-event signatures and manifest, manifest shows contiguous sequence window for lease period, and customer can replay using resume tokens within the lease TTL.
investigation_notes:
2026-03-12: Intake call with CS and customer to clarify scope. Confirmed legal hold and explicit non-redaction consent. Customer provided certs and sample events.
2026-03-12: SRE reviewed streaming pipeline constraints; noted that current webhook infra supports per-event HMAC but not an end-of-window signed manifest natively.
2026-03-13: Proposed approach: create ephemeral lease record in routing service, turn on ordered delivery mode for tenant, enable per-event hmac header (X-Redwood-HMAC) and acknowledgement token header (X-Redwood-Ack). Implement manifest assembly in audit-archiver job which will compute sequence hashes and sign with audit key. Temporary keys to be rotated after lease.
Hypotheses: latency should remain within SLO since volume for tenant is moderate; main work is manifest generation and atomicity guarantees while archiver writes manifest at lease end.
Open risks: ensuring no partial manifests if archiver crashes; need abort/rollback behavior and a clear resume token hygiene policy to avoid replay outside TTL.
comments: 2026-03-12 - Aisha Khan (Customer Success): Kicked off request after legal advisory asked for provable delivery for AML investigation. Customer needs delivery proof by EOD 2026-03-13.

2026-03-12 - Miguel Torres (SRE): Reviewed pipeline; can enable per-event HMAC and ack tokens. Need engineering change for signed manifest. Escalating to infra team for a short-lived manifest job. Filed INT-1012 to track infra work.

2026-03-13 - Customer (NorthStar Contacts): Provided mTLS certs and endpoint. Confirmed they will accept ed25519 signatures from Redwood audit key. Asked whether resume tokens include replay limits and whether we can provide sample verification code.

2026-03-13 - Miguel Torres (SRE): Requested additional info: sample event JSON with exact fields to preserve, expected throughput estimate, and PII handling confirmation (they confirmed no redaction during lease).
2026-03-13 - Legal/Trust (internal): Noted we must record an explicit consent log and attach the legal request to the ticket. Asked CS to collect signed authorization from the customer's legal team.
work_items: Create ephemeral webhook lease controller that can be scoped to tenant and TTL
Add per-event ack token (ed25519-signed) header generation in audit emitter
Add X-Redwood-HMAC header (sha256) using tenant envelope key
Implement manifest assembler job in audit-archiver that signs final manifest
Provide verification playbook and sample code snippets for customer
Run a 72-hour test window in staging and one 3-hour pilot in prod for ns-payments-prod
